messages:
sophia: Quick thread to pin down pilot gates for Optimize toolkit (batching/caching/quant recs/eval alerts). Need clear pass/fail criteria and owners.

jamal: From PM perspective here's a minimal gate set we can agree on: p95 latency <= 120ms on short sequences (<=128 tokens); end-to-end unit-cost reduction >= 12% for pilot workloads; eval_regressions <= 1% on our core prompt suite; and at least one non-trivial canary with a pilot customer without rollback.

devin: Engineering realities: we must validate hardware coverage (A100/H100/T4 equiv), verify fallback routing (model -> quant -> smaller model), and ensure cache eviction semantics are stable under load. Also batching heuristics must not increase P99 more than 10%. Estimate 2 sprints plus 2 days infra setup.

raj: ML acceptance: per-model quant profiles with calibration, quality delta <0.5% on primary metric (EM or ROUGE depending on model), and token-level telemetry to detect drift. For eval-triggered alerts we need a false-positive budget (recommend <= 5%) and sampling rules.

lisa: Customer side: Console opt-in is required, plus a migration guide and rollback instructions. Also a short "what to expect" doc for pilot customers showing likely perf/cost deltas. We should prepare customer comm templates for alerting.

jamal: Proposed rollout/canary config example (ops copy):
```
canary:
  duration: 72h
  traffic: 5%
  metrics:
    latency_p95: <=120ms
    eval_regression: <=1%
  rollback_if:
    - eval_regression > 1%
    - error_rate_increase > 0.5%
```

devin: We should prioritize model families for sweeps; can't run everything. Suggest Llama2-13B, Mistral-7B, and a quant-pruned 70B. That gives coverage for small/medium/large tradeoffs.

raj: I'll run calibration + eval on those three and upload results to the PR. I'll include per-model calibration artifacts and the delta table.

eng-infra-bot: infra: Noted. We can provision canary infra in 48h after a requisition. Need exact model list and expected QPS.

ops-bot: deployment-bot: Canary job queued for branch optimize-toolkit/pilot-canary-2026-03

sophia: Next steps: jamal to draft the PR with checklist + canary config; devin to run benchmark sweep on prioritized families; raj to run calibration and eval; lisa to draft customer docs; eng-infra to provision test infra. Target ship window: end of sprint (~3 weeks). Scheduling 30m sync Fri to lock owners. Any other blockers?

jamal: None from PM.

devin: Ping @eng-infra for approval; will need 2 working days to set up test harness.

raj: Need access to latest eval dataset (pinging data-platform).

lisa: I'll confirm two pilot customers this morning.

sophia: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
